SAP Cloud Platform
Market Cloud specializes in implementing solutions on the SAP Cloud Platform and S/4HANA delivery for cloud or on-premise. Our projects range from aerospace, consumer goods and pharma to global manufacturing and distribution.
SAP Analytics
Market Cloud is renowned for its focus on innovation. Our expertise in SAP Analytics allows customers to better take advantage of opportunities in the digital economy with technologies such as blockchain, big data, analytics, IoT and machine learning.

Strategic and Operational Growth.

How to transition from SAP ECC 6.0 to S/4 HANA
SAP S/4HANA transformation includes migrating from an old SAP ERP system, such as SAP ECC, which runs on-premise, to SAP’s simplified S/4HANA business suite, hosted either on-premise, in the cloud, or as a hybrid. Migrating all your data and operations to S/4HANA with the SAP Activate methodology approach.
New or existing SAP customers implementing a new SAP S/4HANA system with initial data load.
Complete conversion of an existing SAP Business Suite system to SAP S/4HANA
Consolidation of the current regional SAP Business Suite landscape or selective data transformation into one global SAP S/4HANA system
What are the transformation challenges?
The migration to a new ERP system is not a typical IT project but rather a fundamental system change, and its implementation is associated with some challenges.
Our study with partners identified the biggest transformation hurdles, such as:
Existing complex IT landscapes
Unclean master data
Company-specific ABAP custom code that is not compatible with S/4 HANA
Creating inconsistent business processes that need to be harmonized before migration.
Change management lacks the necessary expertise to develop the right strategy.
Slow or blocked migration process due to individual stakeholders
S/4 HANA transformation approaches
Greenfield approach - New implementation
If a company decides to adopt the Greenfield approach, it has the advantage that it only contains the necessary processes and data.
If a company completely redefines its enterprise architecture, innovations can also be integrated more efficiently, and a high level of functionality can be achieved.
However, when switching to the SAP S/4HANA cloud version, the Greenfield approach is unavoidable as the systems are entirely replaced.
Brownfield approach - System conversion
With the Brownfield approach, a system conversion takes place. This means that existing business processes are taken over and optimized if necessary.
Since most companies do not want to completely abandon their custom ERP system, the Brownfield approach is the most popular migration path. The majority of customers use a brownfield approach.
Hybrid approach - Selective data transition
The hybrid approach is a method that large companies with complex system landscapes can use to prepare for transformation. This means that databases are cleaned up and consolidated to reduce the footprint before the change.
Companies can also use this approach to combine several vendor ERP systems. Such a simplification is also possible during the actual transformation. Whether this makes sense depends on the system landscape and the target system. An enterprise architect often works with all three approaches to achieve the best possible approach.
Benefits of Digital Transformation with SAP S/4 HANA
Proven best practices
Comes with business processes that incorporate industry-standard best practices
Fast time to value
Jump-starts you with a guided implementation process, fast technical setup, and a role-based, intuitive interface
Automatic and continual updates
SAP fully manages updates, so you don’t need extensive IT resources or risk disruption to the business
Continuous innovation
Adds the latest technology, such as built-in AI, machine learning, robotic process automation, and analytics, so your business can operate better
Security, compliance, and scalability
Handles technical operations, including backup and disaster recovery, system maintenance, data protection, and best-in-class uptimes to give you peace of mind
Open and extensible
Provides ready-to-go APIs with supporting tools and documentation so you can easily integrate with your partners or build on top of SAP B2B cloud platform integration.
